title: Price percent of sector leader
statementMd:
On 2024-04-15 show each ticker's close as a percentage of the highest close within its sector that day (rounded to 1 decimal). Show symbol, sector and percentage.

Expected columns: `symbol`, `sector`, `pct_of_leader`.

Tables: `tickers`, `prices`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT p.symbol, t.sector, ROUND(100.0 * p.close / MAX(p.close) OVER (PARTITION BY t.sector), 1) AS pct_of_leader FROM prices p JOIN tickers t ON t.symbol = p.symbol WHERE p.trade_date = '2024-04-15';
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
